learning_objective: 🎯 To understand that true winning is not just about getting the first prize, but showing fair play, kindness, and amazing sportsmanship!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Everyone is excited about a huge competition. The participants have practiced very hard, and everyone wants to cross the finish line first to win the shiny trophy.
Right in the middle of the intense race, one of the best runners trips and falls to the ground. They are hurt and cannot get back up on their own.
Another runner who is winning sees the fallen friend. They have to make a tough choice: keep running for the gold medal, or stop and help their friend.
The runner stops, helps the fallen friend, and they finish the race together. The crowd cheers loudly because helping others makes you the ultimate winner in life!

fun_activity.title: 🎭 Award the True Winner!
fun_activity.instructions: Design a special gold medal on a piece of paper. Instead of writing 'Fastest Runner', write a title for someone who shows great sportsmanship!

quick_recap: ⭐ All participants were eager to win the big running competition.
⭐ During the race, a strong runner suddenly tripped and fell down.
⭐ A leading competitor sacrificed their chance of winning to help.
⭐ True victory lies in compassion and fair play, not just crossing the finish line.
